entities.summary: Andrew Shaw is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He was selected in the fifth round, 139th overall, by the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2011 NHL entry draft and is a two-time Stanley Cup champion with the Blackhawks. Shaw also played for the Montreal Canadiens prior to the end of his career in 2021 due to suffering multiple concussions.
